description.zh: 时间段描述，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符。
description.en: The description of the time period. The description can be 1 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

description.zh: 时间段结束时间，格式为二十四小时制时间，范围为00:00~23:59，不能早于StartTime。
description.en: The end time of the time period, in 24-hour format. Valid values range from 00:00 to 23:59. The value cannot be earlier than StartTime.

description.zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify it.
></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>
The unique identifier of the time period.

description.zh: 时间段声码解析内容，长度为1~512个字符，一个汉字占两个字符。
description.en: The content parsed from the sound code during the time period. The content can be 1 to 512 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

description.zh: 时间段开始时间，格式为二十四小时制时间，范围为00:00~23:59。
description.en: The start time of the time period, in 24-hour format. Valid values range from 00:00 to 23:59.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为2。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 2 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot update-schedule-period --sound-code-content www.taobao.com --period-code Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --description test --start-time 00:00 --end-time 01:00 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot UpdateSchedulePeriod --region cn-hangzhou --Description test --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --EndTime '01:00' --StartTime '00:00' --SoundCodeContent 'www.taobao.com' --PeriodCode Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000
